stops.note: 'a giving, grant', from dati 'to give'; it meant land granted by a Muscovite prince in return for service
Peter the Great granted plots along the road from St Petersburg to Peterhof to his courtiers, and the word shifted to the country houses built on them
used for Russian summer houses; Stalin's 'Near Dacha' at Kuntsevo, where he died in 1953, made it familiar in reporting on the Kremlin

current_meaning: a country house or cottage in Russia, typically a second home
